items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 49:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the coupling of back to back? The coupling at the time of the slumber and the Nesira, when ZON ascend to Aba and Ima, and ZA is included in Aba, and the Nukva is included in Ima, and they couple with one another, is discerned as the coupling of back to back. And although while they are in the palace of Aba and Ima, they are face to face, like Aba and Ima while they are included in them, nevertheless the Nukva needs to receive those Mochin a second time, by means of ZA himself, after his coming to his place. And when they come to their place they are back to back, for those Mochin are the Mochin of the back, as is known. (Item 103).
